summary: Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of 150+ jet-powered Shahed drones and dozens of missiles, with Tu-160 strategic bombers taking off from Belaya airbase for potential cruise missile strikes. Ukrainian air defenses engaged reactive UAVs across at least ten oblasts including Kyiv, Odesa, Cherkasy, Zaporizhzhia, Kirovohrad, and Sumy, with impacts reported in Kropyvnytskyi and Kyiv's Svyatoshynskyi district. Meanwhile, the Chonhar bridge linking occupied Crimea to Kherson collapsed, a Russian strike damaged a Dnipro River bridge in Zaporizhzhia injuring five including Red Cross workers, and a major fuel depot near Moscow burned.
key_points: Russia launched 150+ jet-powered Shahed drones and dozens of missiles overnight, with Tu-160 bombers airborne from Belaya airbase. (Source: @kpszsu/83368, @mon1tor_ua/76122)

Reactive UAVs penetrated at least ten Ukrainian oblasts: Kyiv, Odesa, Cherkasy, Zaporizhzhia, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Chernihiv, Sumy. (Source: @kpszsu/83342, @eRadarrua/120502)

Jet Shahed struck Kropyvnytskyi outskirts; Geran-5 rocket hit Kyiv's Svyatoshynskyi district; ballistic missiles expected after 23:30. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76093, @mon1tor_ua/76127, @mon1tor_ua/76128)
Chonhar bridge collapsed between occupied Crimea and Kherson, disrupting Russian military logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/84510)
Russian strike on Dnipro River bridge in Zaporizhzhia injured five, including two Red Cross workers. (Source: @UkraineNow/84509)
Major fuel depot (Volodarskaya station) near Moscow burned, supplying Vnukovo, Domodedovo, Sheremetyevo airports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84508)
Ukrainian drones struck Snezhnyansk machine-building plant in occupied Donetsk, producing aviation engine components. (Source: @UkraineNow/84517)
Two civilian vessels attacked in Bulgarian waters by Russian sea/air drones; one sunk, one damaged. (Source: @UkraineNow/84519)

points: Ukrainian air defenses engaged reactive UAVs across at least ten oblasts overnight, including Kyiv, Odesa, Cherkasy, Zaporizhzhia, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Chernihiv, and Sumy, with monitoring channels reporting dozens of individual drone tracks. (Source: @kpszsu/83342, @eRadarrua/120502, @mon1tor_ua/76134)
A jet-powered Shahed struck the outskirts of Kropyvnytskyi, with a second drone falling in the same area, per monitoring reports. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76093, @mon1tor_ua/76092)
A Geran-5 rocket impacted Kyiv's Svyatoshynskyi district, prompting air raid alerts across the capital region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76127)
The Chonhar bridge linking occupied Crimea to Kherson collapsed, causing traffic jams and disrupting Russian military logistics, per Ukrainian sources. (Source: @UkraineNow/84510)

Ukrainian drones struck the Snezhnyansk machine-building plant in occupied Donetsk, which produces aviation engine components for Russian attack aircraft and combat helicopters. (Source: @UkraineNow/84517)
SBU, with FBI assistance, detained the founder of a Telegram channel calling for terrorist attacks and providing explosives instructions in Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/84512)
A KIIS poll shows 53% of Ukrainians oppose Zelensky running in potential presidential elections, up from 34% in late 2023. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33759)

Russian forces launched a massive overnight barrage of 150+ jet-powered Shahed drones and dozens of missiles, with monitoring channels warning of continued launches through the night and morning. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76122)
Three Tu-160 strategic bombers took off from Belaya airbase; if cruise missiles are launched, entry into Ukrainian airspace expected after 03:00. (Source: @kpszsu/83368)
Drone launches detected from Primorsko-Akhtarsk (11 groups), Gvardeyskoye (2 groups), Orel (1 group), and Shatalovo (12 groups), per radar monitoring. (Source: @eRadarrua/120502, @eRadarrua/120465)
A Russian strike hit a Dnipro River bridge in Zaporizhzhia, temporarily closing traffic and injuring five people, including two Red Cross workers. (Source: @UkraineNow/84509)
A major fuel depot (Volodarskaya station) near Moscow caught fire, the largest in the region supplying Vnukovo, Domodedovo, and Sheremetyevo airports. (Source: @UkraineNow/84508)
Russian combined sea and air drones attacked two civilian vessels in Bulgarian waters; one sank, the other sustained significant damage. (Source: @UkraineNow/84519)
South Korea reportedly supplied fuel to Russia via seven sanctioned tankers making 14 voyages, using false destinations to conceal routes. (Source: @UkraineNow/84511)

Ukrainian drones struck the Snezhnyansk machine-building plant in occupied Donetsk, which manufactures aviation engine components for Russian attack aircraft and combat helicopters. (Source: @UkraineNow/84517)
Russian forces struck a bridge across the Dnipro River in Zaporizhzhia, injuring five civilians including two Red Cross workers and halting traffic. (Source: @UkraineNow/84509)
Reactive UAVs were reported over southern Zaporizhzhia heading toward Mykolaiv, and over northern Odesa heading toward Vinnytsia. (Source: @kpszsu/83338, @eRadarrua/120464)
A jet-powered UAV was observed near the Chornobyl exclusion zone heading toward Zhytomyr region. (Source: @kpszsu/83352)
Monitoring channels reported reactive UAVs over Kirovohrad and Mykolaiv oblasts, with groups approaching from the Black Sea toward Ochakiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/120484, @kpszsu/83370)
Russian forces continue to use the Snezhnyansk plant for military production, making it a recurring target for Ukrainian strikes. (Source: @UkraineNow/84517)
The eastern front remains under persistent drone pressure with multiple vectors targeting rear areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76132)
Reactive UAVs entered Chernihiv region from the west of Chernihiv city heading south, and from Belarus direction toward Slavutych. (Source: @kpszsu/83337, @eRadarrua/120504)
A ballistic missile threat was reported in Sumy region, with a probable ballistic missile in the area per monitoring. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76134)
Jet-powered drones crossed from Vinnytsia toward Khmelnytskyi, and from Boromlya (Sumy) toward Poltava. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76131, @eRadarrua/120523)
Multiple reactive UAV groups tracked over Zhytomyr region heading toward Kyiv region (Makariv/Nalyvaikivka) and Poltava region. (Source: @eRadarrua/120523, @eRadarrua/120496)
Air raid alerts activated across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Poltava oblasts due to drone threat. (Source: @eRadarrua/120510, @eRadarrua/120507)
A group of reactive UAVs bypassed Kyiv reservoir heading toward Vyshhorod/Kyiv. (Source: @kpszsu/83358)
Russian launches from Shatalovo (12 groups) and Gvardeyskoye (2 groups) likely target northern and central Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/120465)
The Chonhar bridge connecting occupied Crimea to Kherson collapsed, causing traffic jams and disrupting Russian military logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/84510)
Reactive UAVs launched from the Black Sea toward Ochakiv (Mykolaiv region) and from northern Odesa toward Vinnytsia. (Source: @kpszsu/83370, @kpszsu/83338)
A jet-powered UAV was reported west of Odesa near Ovidiopol heading south. (Source: @kpszsu/83342)
